title: LongBEL: Long-Context and Document-Consistent Biomedical Entity Linking
abstract: arXiv:2605.13451v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biomedical entity linking maps textual mentions to concepts in structured knowledge bases such as UMLS or SNOMED CT. Most existing systems link each mention independently, using only the mention or its surrounding sentence. This ignores dependencies between mentions in the same document and can lead to inconsistent predictions, especially when the same concept appears under different surface forms. We introduce LongBEL, a document-level generative framework that combines full-document context with a memory of previous predictions. To make this memory robust, LongBEL is trained with cross-validated predictions rather than gold labels, reducing the mismatch between training and inference and limiting cascading errors. Experiments on five biomedical benchmarks across English, French, and Spanish show that LongBEL improves over sentence-level generative baselines, with the largest gains on datasets where concepts frequently recur within

translated_title: LongBEL：长上下文与文档一致性的生物医学实体链接
translated_abstract: 生物医学实体链接是将文本中的提及映射到结构化知识库（如UMLS或SNOMED CT）中概念的任务。现有的大多数系统独立地链接每个提及，仅使用该提及本身或其所在的句子。这种做法忽略了同一文档中各提及之间的依赖关系，可能导致预测不一致，尤其当同一概念以不同的表面形式出现时更为明显。我们提出了LongBEL，这是一个文档级生成框架，它将整篇文档的上下文与对先前预测的记忆相结合。为了使这种记忆更加稳健，LongBEL使用交叉验证的预测而非黄金标准标签进行训练，从而减少了训练与推理之间的不匹配，并限制了级联错误。在涵盖英语、法语和西班牙语的五个生物医学基准数据集上的实验表明，LongBEL优于句子级生成基线，其中在概念于文档内频繁重复出现的数据集上提升最为显著。
tldr: LongBEL提出了一种结合全文档上下文与先前预测记忆的文档级生物医学实体链接框架，通过交叉验证预测进行训练以减少训练-推理不匹配和级联错误，在多语言基准上显著优于句子级基线方法。
